title: Unit tests for parseToolCallBlock and parseTextBlocks (src/apps/ide/agent-loop.ts)
instructions:
Add a new vitest unit test file `tests/ide/parse-tool-call-block.test.ts` for `parseToolCallBlock and parseTextBlocks` in `src/apps/ide/agent-loop.ts`.
- Read the code first (it is pasted below) and assert what it actually does; if you think the code has a bug, say so in your final answer instead of changing it.
- Use `import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";` and import the code under test with a relative path ending in `.js` (for example `../../src/apps/ide/agent-loop.js`), like the other tests in this repository.
- Cover parseToolCallBlock: valid JSON with tool and args; args missing or not an object gives {}; a missing or empty tool, a non-string tool and malformed JSON give null. Cover parseTextBlocks: ```tool_call and ```plan fences are found in order with their bodies; text with no fences gives [].
